title: procurement-tools conformance record
description: One candidate judged against one revision of one variant of one spec. Written by the evaluation-matrix skill, one file per candidate under evaluation/conformance/. Deliberately per-candidate rather than one big table so that independent subagents can each write one without colliding. When a spec has variants, one candidate yields one record per variant it was judged against.

revision.description: The spec revision this was judged against. If the spec has moved on, the record is stale and says so rather than being silently reused.

variant.description: The spec variant this was judged against. Omitted when the spec has no variants. Must be present whenever the spec carries one — a record that does not say which variant it was judged against cannot be placed in a matrix, because the same verdict can be a pass under budget and a fail under premium.

spec.description: Which spec, variant and revision this verdict was reached against. All three pin the judgement; any of them moving makes the record stale rather than wrong.

region.description: Region the part number belongs to. A US part number and its EU sibling are separate candidates unless part-number-equivalence has confirmed them identical.

equivalence_ref.description: Path to the equivalence record, when this candidate is a regional sibling of another.

datasheet_ref.description: Path to the datasheet record produced by spec-sheet-retrieval.

evaluated_by.description: Agent or person. Useful when several subagents filled different rows.

verdict.description: unknown is a real answer and outranks a guess. partial requires a condition in note.

value.description: The observed value, in the requirement's unit. Present even on a pass — the number is what a later reader checks.

conflicting_sources.description: Populated when sources disagree. A contested spec is recorded as unknown WITH both sources, never resolved by picking the nicer number.

resolves_to.description: On unknown: what would settle it. A question for the vendor, a document that does not exist, a test only hands-on use answers.

type.description: Ranked in the evidence table in skills/evaluation-matrix/SKILL.md. retail-listing and review never settle a must on their own.

doc_revision.description: The datasheet's own revision/date stamp, which is not the same as when you fetched it.

quote.description: The line the verdict rests on, verbatim.

egress.description: Which country the fetch left from, where that changes the content (regional catalogues, regional spec variants).
